div.div: On HA failover: PAN-OS on FW2 calls EC2 API using its IAM instance profile to (1) move the Floating EIP from FW1 untrust ENI to FW2 untrust ENI, and (2) update the trust route table next-hop to point to FW2's trust ENI. Failover completes in ~30–60 seconds.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 844px; margin-left: 38px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div: HA1 (TCP 28769): heartbeat + hello messages. Firewall monitors this link to detect peer failure. HA2 (TCP 28778): bulk session state sync. Passive firewall holds a live copy of all sessions — in-flight connections survive failover with minimal packet loss.
